title: Enforcement Decree of the Oil Pollution Damage Compensation Guarantee Act
full_text:
Enforcement Decree of the Oil Pollution Damage Compensation Guarantee Act

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Oil Pollution Damage Compensation Guarantee Act and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Oil)
"Those prescribed by Presidential Decree" in subparagraph 5 of Article 2 of the Oil Pollution Damage Compensation Guarantee Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means the following oils:
1. Crude oil;
2. Heavy fuel oil;
3. Bunker fuel oil;
4. Lubricating oil;
5. Hydrocarbon oils other than those specified in subparagraphs 1 through 4, of which no more than 50 percent by volume distills at temperatures of 340 degrees Celsius or below when tested in accordance with the method for testing the distillation of petroleum products under the Korean Industrial Standards referred to in Article 12 of the Industrial Standardization Act.

Article 3 (Contributing Oil)
"Oil prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 26 (1) of the Act means the oils specified in Annex 1.

Article 4 (Persons Controlling the Business Activities of Oil Receivers)
Persons controlling the business activities of an oil receiver under Article 26 (3) of the Act shall be persons who own more than one-half of the total issued shares or equity interests, respectively, of an oil receiver that is a corporation.

Article 5 (Delegation and Entrustment of Authority)
(1) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall delegate the following authority to the heads of Regional Offices of Oceans and Fisheries pursuant to Article 57 (1) of the Act: <Amended on March 23, 2013; January 6, 2015>
1. Orders to suspend navigation under Article 14 (3) of the Act;
2. Refusal of entry into or departure from domestic ports and disapproval of the use of domestic mooring facilities under Article 14 (4) of the Act;
3. Issuance and reissuance of guarantee contract certificates under Article 18 of the Act;
4. Acceptance of reports on changes to particulars entered in guarantee contract certificates and issuance of new guarantee contract certificates under Article 19 of the Act;
5. Issuance and reissuance of guarantee contract certificates for general ships and oil storage barges under Article 18 of the Act, as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 49 of the Act;
6. Acceptance of reports on changes to particulars entered in guarantee contract certificates for general ships and oil storage barges, and issuance of new guarantee contract certificates, under Article 19 of the Act, as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to Article 49 of the Act;
7. Acceptance of notifications of guarantee contract information and notifications of changes thereto under Article 54 of the Act;
8. Orders to submit relevant documents, entry for inspection, and verification under Article 55 of the Act (excluding verification of reports on the quantity of contributing oil under Article 26 of the Act);
9. Imposition and collection of administrative fines under Article 65 of the Act.
(2) Pursuant to Article 57 (2) of the Act, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may entrust the following duties to a specialized institution for the prevention of maritime disasters designated by the Minister under paragraph (3): <Amended on March 23, 2013>
1. Receipt and processing of reports on the quantity of contributing oil under Article 26 (1) and (2) of the Act;
2. Notifications and forwarding of documents under Article 27 (1) of the Act, and notification of the quantity of contributing oil under paragraph (2) of that Article;
3. Demands for the payment of contributions under Article 29 of the Act.
(3) When designating an entrusted institution under paragraph (2), the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall select an institution performing the following functions: <Amended on March 23, 2013>
1. Surveys and research for the prevention of oil pollution incidents;
2. Pollution control activities when oil pollution incidents occur;
3. International cooperation for the prevention of and compensation for oil pollution damage;
4. Other matters concerning the prevention of maritime disasters.
(4) When designating an entrusted institution under paragraph (2), the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall determine the details of the entrusted duties, the method of handling them, and other necessary matters, and publicly notify them in the Official Gazette. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 6 (Criteria for Imposing Administrative Fines)
(1) The criteria for imposing administrative fines under Article 65 (1) of the Act shall be as specified in Annex 2.
(2) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may reduce or increase the amount of an administrative fine specified in Annex 2 by up to one-half of that amount, taking into account the severity and frequency of the relevant violation and other circumstances. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 21851, November 26, 2009>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on November 28, 2009.

Article 2 (Relations with Other Statutes and Regulations)
Where any other statute or regulation cites a former provision at the time this Decree enters into force, and this Decree contains a corresponding provision, the corresponding provision of this Decree shall be deemed cited in lieu of the former provision.

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 24443, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (127) Omitted.

(128) The Enforcement Decree of the Oil Pollution Damage Compensation Guarantee Act is partially amended as follows:

In the portions other than the subparagraphs of Article 5 (1), (2), and (3), and in Articles 5 (4) and 6 (2), "Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" shall be replaced with "Minister of Oceans and Fisheries" in each instance.

(129) through (146) Omitted.

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 25985, January 6, 2015>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (16) Omitted.

(17) The Enforcement Decree of the Oil Pollution Damage Compensation Guarantee Act is partially amended as follows:

In the portion other than the subparagraphs of Article 5 (1), "head of a Regional Maritime Affairs and Port Office" shall be replaced with "head of a Regional Office of Oceans and Fisheries".

(18) through (30) Omitted.

Article 5 Omitted.

ADDENDA (Presidential Decree on Partial Amendments to 473 Statutes and Regulations to Improve Difficult Legal Terminology) <Presidential Decree No. 31380, January 5, 2021>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>
